request: The CRM should alert us when our relationship with a country goes cold.
executive_summary: This release will implement an alert system that notifies users when engagement levels with a country drop below a defined threshold and enhance data accuracy for compliance. The system will not include integrations with external notification systems or allow changes to the 'cold' definition from a 6-month period. Key decisions remain regarding ownership transfers for project managers and compliance practices, including retention of cold engagement records.

core_commitments.text: Enable users to receive alerts when engagement levels with any country drop below a specified threshold.
core_commitments.note: This commitment enables users to receive alerts when engagement levels drop, a core aspect of the request.

in_scope.text: Define 'cold' engagement as any country that has had no formal documented contact recorded in the system for a period of 6 months, while including informal engagements that are logged as exceptions. Implement a verification process that ensures the engagement history is accurate, which includes a regular audit of logged engagements every 3 months.
in_scope.note: Defining 'cold' engagement includes formal contacts for 6 months with exceptions for informal engagements, ensuring clarity in notifications.

in_scope.text: Implement a notification system that sends alerts only to regional coordinators and project managers who are actively assigned to manage the country in the CRM, ensuring that notifications are limited to authorized personnel.
in_scope.note: Limiting alerts to regional coordinators and project managers addresses confidentiality concerns about sensitive information sharing.

in_scope.text: Allow users to configure the alert notification settings within their user profiles.
in_scope.note: Allowing users to configure alert settings supports individual user preferences, enhancing usability of the feature.

in_scope.text: Provide a dashboard widget that displays countries whose relationships are currently classified as 'cold'.
in_scope.note: The dashboard widget is a useful tool for visualizing cold relationships, contributing to proactive management.

out_of_scope.text: This release will not include integrations with external notification systems (e.g., email alerts, SMS alerts).
out_of_scope.note: Integrations with external systems are out of scope to keep the project focused and manageable at this stage.

out_of_scope.text: This release will not allow users to change the definition of 'cold' to a time frame other than 6 months.
out_of_scope.note: Not allowing changes to the definition of 'cold' engagement ensures a consistent application of the criteria across users and use cases.

assumptions.text: Users have access to the CRM system where relationships and engagements are logged, which the alert feature depends on.
assumptions.note: Assuming users have access to the CRM is crucial for the functionality of alerts as part of their management responsibilities.

assumptions.text: User roles are already established within the CRM, allowing for differentiated access to features such as alerts, which this proposal relies on.
assumptions.note: Established user roles are fundamental to ensuring that access restrictions align with the sensitive nature of data involved in the alerts.

assumptions.text: The organization has defined engagement activities that can be tracked in order to determine when a relationship is classified as 'cold'.
assumptions.note: Defined engagement activities are necessary for classification purposes, ensuring that the alert system can function accurately.

definitions.text: 'Cold' engagement means having no documented contact recorded between the organization and a country within the last 6 months.
definitions.note: Clarifying the definition of 'cold' engagement avoids ambiguity in the alert system, contributing to effective communication strategies.

definitions.text: 'Alert notification' means a message generated by the CRM system that informs users of a change in a relationship status.
definitions.note: Defining 'alert notification' provides a clear understanding of what users can expect from the alert system features.

definitions.text: 'Users' refers to regional coordinators and project managers who have the authority to manage relationships with government counterparts.
definitions.note: Clearly defining 'users' ensures the intended audience for notifications is understood, safeguarding sensitive information.

success_criteria.text: At least 80% of users receive the alert notification within 24 hours of the engagement status being classified as 'cold', measured through user feedback and system logs.
success_criteria.note: Setting a target of 80% for alert notifications ensures a measurable success criterion for this feature implementation.

open_questions.question: What process will be established for transferring ownership of relationships when project managers leave or change roles?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This decision impacts continuity and effectiveness in managing government relationships.
options: Allow project managers to assign successors

open_questions.question: What quality control measures will be put in place to ensure the accuracy of engagement history?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Accurate engagement history is critical to prevent false alerts and maintain effective communications.
options: Implement regular audits of engagement records

open_questions.question: What will be the defined retention period for records related to cold engagements?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This is essential for compliance and ensures that critical historical information is not lost.
options: Set a fixed retention period (e.g., 2 years)
Adopt a rolling review process for records

open_questions.question: How long will records related to cold engagements be retained?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Retention policies directly affect compliance and operational effectiveness in managing relationships.

tension.summary: The real disagreement focused on data ownership and compliance risks related to undefined retention policies for cold engagement records. While the Proposer emphasized the importance of defining the alert system's parameters, the Critic stressed the need for organizational decisions on handling ownership transfers and compliance measures, leading to unresolved questions.

proposer.worry: Ensuring the implemented verification process effectively identifies and corrects any inaccuracies in engagement records.

critic.worry: Unresolved compliance risk due to undefined retention policies for cold engagement records.
